text: Techniques and methods to mark AI-generated content - watermarks, metadata identifications, cryptographic methods for proving provenance and authenticity of content, logging methods, or fingerprints - should be sufficiently reliable, interoperable, effective and robust as far as technically feasible, taking into account available techniques and the generally acknowledged state of the art.
notes: This recital provides interpretive context for the Article 50(2) marking and detection obligation. Text sourced from the README inline snippet; verify against OJ L 2024/1689.
